svg.title: PTAP architecture and instruction routing
svg.desc: The jtag_ptap module. The .tck and .tms of client_tap_ctrl_i reach the TAP controller u_jtag_tap_ctrlr directly; its .trst_n is ANDed with pwr_on_rst_ni into jtag_trst_n, the TRST of the controller and of the retimer. The controller forwards TCK, TMS and jtag_trst_n on host_tap_ctrl_o, drives stap_host_scan_ctrl_o with the IR and DR scan controls ORed together and ANDed with stap_select from TAP_3DCR, drives current_state_o and client_tdo_oen_o, and passes the IR and DR scan controls to the scan registers. The optional TMP controller u_jtag_tmp takes inst_decoded_o and bypass_escape_bit and returns persistence_mode to the TAP controller. client_tdi_i feeds the 6-bit instruction register u_jtag_inst_reg and every test data register. The instruction register decodes its opcode one-hot onto inst_decoded_o[63:0], and the decoded opcode selects one register: BYPASS for 00, 07, 08, 0A, 0B, 3F and every opcode without its own register, INV_BYPASS for 3E, IDCODE for 01, TAP_3DCR for 0E, TMP_STATUS for 0C, IC_RESET for 0D, DEBUG_CONTROL for 18, JTAG_CAPS for 19, the three JTAG2AXI_CAPS registers for 1B, 21 and 27, the SMC OTP, SEP OTP and SMC fabric jtag2axi bridges for 1C to 20, 22 to 26 and 28 to 2C, the external boundary-scan chain for 03 to 06 and 09 and the external iJTAG network for 1A and 02. Optional registers and bridges are dashed. The bridges drive AXI-Lite to the SMC and SEP OTP and AXI4 to the SMC fabric, each blocked by its own security_disable_i input. Every register output, and the boundary-scan and iJTAG returns, enter tdr_mux, which ir_scan_ctrl.select and inst_decoded_o steer. u_zlb_tdr_mux passes tdr_mux on input 0 and client_tdi_i on input 1; its output leaves as stap_host_scan_out_o. u_tdo_mux passes that on input 0 and stap_host_scan_in_i on input 1, selected by stap_select from TAP_3DCR. The result is retimed on the falling TCK edge, and u_tdo_bypass_mux passes the retimed value on input 0 and the unretimed value on input 1 to client_tdo_o. u_zlb_tdr_mux and u_tdo_bypass_mux share one select: inst_decoded_o for ZERO_LENGTH_BYPASS (3D) ANDed with dr_scan_select_reg.
